verdict.rationale: Docs mention filtering/segmenting errors by 'custom tags' (raygun-docs-3) and removing sensitive data before sending (raygun-docs-12), implying some ability to attach custom metadata to events, but there is no evidence of a breadcrumb API, explicit user-context attachment, or SDK instrumentation guidance for attaching state to individual events. Missing for 10: breadcrumb trail API, explicit user identification/context object, SDK code examples showing tags/custom data attachment per event.
